Frequently Asked Questions

What is business automation?

Business automation is the use of software, artificial intelligence (AI), and workflows to automate repetitive tasks. It helps businesses save time, reduce manual errors, improve efficiency, and increase overall productivity..

How does workflow automation work?

Workflow automation connects different business processes using predefined rules and triggers. When a specific action occurs, the system automatically performs the next step without requiring manual intervention.

What are the benefits of workflow automation?

Workflow automation reduces repetitive work, minimizes human errors, improves collaboration, speeds up approvals, increases productivity, and helps businesses scale operations more efficiently.

What is CRM automation?

CRM automation automatically manages customer interactions, follow-ups, lead tracking, reminders, and sales activities, allowing businesses to build stronger customer relationships.

How can CRM automation increase sales?

CRM automation captures leads, schedules follow-ups, sends reminders, and tracks customer interactions, helping sales teams respond faster and convert more prospects into customers.

What is WhatsApp automation?
